steps: The scent, once lingering in the streets, has now vanished.
Around noon, Shia brings me to a small snack shop, saying it serves the most authentic flavors in town.
Huh? Why did they change the sign out front?
Wait, the scent is totally different, too...
Maybe we're in the wrong place? Or they moved?
The owner lives right next door. She's been running this place for decades. I don't think she'd just up and move.
Let's just go inside and take a look.
Welcome to "Sunset Coral: Secret Island Café"~ Will it be a table for two?
Excuse me, is this a new place? I don't think I've seen it here before.
Yes, we had our grand opening last month.
Do you know where did the owner of the previous shop go?
She came by a little while ago to say goodbye to our owner... ==W==Oh right, I think she and her family moved to Sailstead.
Must be nice... I'd love to work in Sailstead, too. Big cities' hourly wage is way better than here.
I see. Thank you for telling us.
Alright, let's order. I'll have a strawberry milk. What about you, Boss?
Let me think... ==W==I'll have the same.
We find a spot by the window and sit down. Shia glances around, taking in the surroundings.
Upon a closer look, the pillars are in the same spots, and the windows haven't changed shape either.==W== Somehow, this makes me feel a bit more at ease...
This is where the snack place used to be?
Yeah. An energetic auntie used to run this place all on her own.
It wasn't nearly this fancy. Just plain wooden tables and chairs, and her little girl doodled on the walls... Definitely not what you'd call tidy.
But everybody liked this place. We would always come here to eat and chat.
By the way, their signature dish was "fresh-fried sardines."
Every morning, auntie would fry up freshly caught sardine right in front. The smell was irresistible. There'd be a long line forming outside first thing in the morning.
It was so crispy and light... Such a shame that you can't try it now.
If it was that popular... Now I really want to know what it tasted like.
Right? Just thinking about that smell is making me crave those fried small fish all over again.
They said she'd moved to Sailstead. Maybe now she's selling those there?
Hmm, hard to say. Since her family asked her to move over... Maybe she's retired?
Still, even if she's really retired, it doesn't mean we'll never see her again. It's fine.
Shia looks a little down somehow... I need to find a way to cheer her up.
Don't worry! Even though we can't have those fried small fish today—
Someday, I'll recreate that flavor. And when I do, Boss, you've gotta try it too♪
I'll look forward to your version of it.
I was worried she'd feel down for a while, but it looks like she's bounced back for now.
After a short break at the café, we pick up where we left off with Shia's "seaside adventure" plan.
This shop's been around forever. They specialize in custom swimsuits. I've been getting mine here since I was a kid!
Since it's not every day you come to visit, I wanted to bring you here to get a swimsuit that fits you perfectly.
Well, actually, I don't get to swim that often...
Really? But even just floating on the water is super relaxing. You won't regret getting one!
When I'm feeling down, I often go surfing.
Ah, I knew it! I recognized that voice right away. Shia! Long time no see~!
Hehe, just kidding. Today I want to ask you to help my friend get a custom swimsuit.
How fast can we get it?
Oh, we don't do custom orders anymore. Now we just sell ready-made swimsuits, like all the other shops.
Custom orders were too much hassle, and they took too long. Tourists didn't want to wait.
Besides, we carry a wide range of sizes. There's always something that fits.
No wonder that scent of sun-dried thread is gone...
The scent of thread? What does she mean?
It's fine. I'll pick something ready-made.
Shia, can you help me pick one? To be honest, I have no idea which to choose.
Really?! You want me to pick one for you?
Hehe, then I'll pick something I like~
After we picked out the swimsuit, Shia took me to a few of her old haunts.
But each of those places has changed, though some more than others. None of them have stayed exactly the way she remembered.
There used to be a little ice cream stand right here...
That sweet, gentle scent of ice cream... And the scent of happy, smiling customers.
You haven't been back for a long time, Shia?
If I count it up, it’s not really that long.
Carlo Town's a small place, after all. Karin and I live nearby in Sailstead for work, but every now and then, I come back to the old house here to clean it up.
But I always just focused on cleaning the house, it didn't occur to me to visit those places...
And got really surprised today... Heh.
So it wasn't just my imagination. Shia really does seem a little down.
I said I'd be your guide, and yet we haven't made it to a single place I wanted to show you...
To make it up to you, let me treat you to a seafood feast tonight, okay?
It's alright, Shia. No need to feel bad. I've been having a great time.
I need to think of a way to cheer her up...
